scope.production: Normal fail-stop execution and machine-state failure codes retained; optional observation channels and services absent
scope.all: Production behavior plus mailbox observation channels, actor snapshots, physical probes, shared debug routing, one routed boundary counter/trace monitor

area_provenance.flow: opt; memory_collect; scramble; synth_xilinx -abc9 -arch xc7 -noiopad -noclkbuf; check; scc

proc
flatten
opt
memory_collect

run_notes: Two mapping workers. Production seed 2 initially aborted in Yosys opt_clean with an invalid free, before name scrambling. Its successful retry used identical frozen sources, script, and tool invocation; the remaining interrupted sweep was completed from those same snapshots.
Warnings are retained by exact message; intermediate loop warnings occur in both variants. Final check -assert and scc -expect 0 pass for every archived mapping.
Best means the smallest count; variance is population variance in squared primitive counts. Five exploratory name-scramble seeds are not a confidence interval.

Functional cycle totals depend on host scheduling. Recovery ends at the latest output when the testbench notices host witness completion, polled every 100 clocks; it is not cycles per application step.
Counters, traces, and final testbench totals are separate observations taken at different cycles.
Paths use ${REPO}; all digests identify original unmodified bytes.
